new_.outside: {n} row(s) are outside the chosen period.
new_.balanceBad: The closing balance does not follow from the opening balance and the rows: it should be {expected}. Look for a missing or doubled row, or a wrong sign.
new_.balanceOk: The balances agree with the rows.

treasury.title: Treasury
treasury.subtitle: Cheques received and issued, their status and due dates. Every change of status makes its own journal entry.
treasury.newSubtitle: Its journal entry is posted as soon as the cheque is registered.
treasury.emptyHint: Register a cheque or change the filters.

actionHint.deposit: The cheque goes to the bank and stays in "cheques in collection" until it is cleared.
actionHint.clear: The money reached the bank account. The clearing entry is posted and shows up in bank reconciliation.
actionHint.bounce: The bank sent the cheque back. It is in hand again and can be deposited again or returned.
actionHint.return: The cheque goes back to its payer and the payer owes the amount again.
actionHint.endorse: You hand the cheque over to a supplier or another account.
actionHint.cancel: The cheque you wrote is voided and the debt to the other party stands again.

filters.searchHint: Number, bank, Sayad id or the name of the party

form.sayadHint: Optional; 16 digits. If given it must be unique.
form.payerAccount: Account of the party (e.g. the customer)
form.payeeAccount: Account of the party (e.g. the supplier)
form.partyHint: A level-3 account that the entry is posted to
form.bankAccountHint: The account the cheque is drawn on
form.entryDateHint: Must be inside an open fiscal year
form.depositAccount: Bank account the cheque is deposited to

settings.title: Treasury settings
settings.subtitle: The accounts the automatic entries of the cheques are posted to.
settings.incomplete: Cheques cannot be registered until all three accounts are set.

hints.cheques_receivable: Received cheques that are still in our hands
hints.cheques_in_collection: Cheques deposited at the bank and not cleared yet
hints.cheques_payable: Cheques we wrote that have not been cashed yet

vouchers.title: Receipts and payments
vouchers.subtitle: Money received and paid (cash, bank, card). Every voucher makes a posted entry; a mistake is corrected by cancelling.
vouchers.newSubtitle: The entry is posted as soon as the voucher is registered. A double click cannot make a second one.
vouchers.searchHint: Number, description or the name of the party
vouchers.emptyHint: Register a new receipt or payment.
vouchers.cancelHint: A posted reversing entry is made. The voucher keeps its number and shows "cancelled".

petty.title: Petty cash
petty.subtitle: Small funds kept by a custodian. The books always show what you gave; expenses are booked when they are settled.
petty.emptyHint: Create a fund with a ceiling.

form.name: Name of the fund
form.accountHint: A level 3 account used only for this fund.

petty.fundHint: Room up to the ceiling: {room} rial.
petty.returnHint: You can take back up to {cash} rial (cash in hand).
petty.expenseHint: Cash in hand: {cash} rial. An expense makes no entry until it is settled.
petty.settleHint: The chosen expenses (or all open ones), {total} rial in all, are booked and paid back to the fund from cash or bank.
petty.cancelSettlementHint: A reversing entry is posted and the expenses of this settlement become "not settled" again.
petty.closeHint: The fund is closed and can no longer change. Its name can be used again.

books.title: Cheque books
books.subtitle: The cheque leaves of our banks. An issued cheque takes its number from a leaf and no leaf is used twice.
books.emptyHint: Register a bank cheque book with its first number and the number of leaves.
books.leafHint: Click a leaf to void it if it is spoiled or lost.
books.issueCheque: Issue a cheque from this book
books.closeHint: The book is closed and gives no more leaves.
books.voidHint: A voided leaf is never used again.
